name: 97630 · Lakeview, OR
findings: ZIP 97630 (Lakeview) has 41 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 97630 (Lakeview) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
65% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 97630 (Lakeview) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 6.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 71% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
